fact: The Automated National Civil Status Register (RNVA/NACSR), established under Ordinance 70-20 as amended by Law 14-08, is in service connecting all municipalities, consulates and institutions such as the Ministry of Justice, and citizens are exempt from submitting documents that authorised institutions retrieve electronically from it.
title: Digital Transformation and Administrative Modernization: The Implementation of Electronic Municipalities in Algeria within the Framework of the e-Government Strategy
publisher: Science, Education and Innovations in the Context of Modern Problems (IMCRA)
